gates.name: max_abs_corr_lt_0_7

gates.name: ff5_alpha_t_ge_3_0_harvey_strict

gates.name: family_level_dedup

gates.measurement: Pairwise correlation clustering. Family defined as connected component where all edges have corr >= 0.95.

gates.name: reproducibility_pending_tag

gates.name: three_variant_decomposition_l146_l155
gates.threshold: Def sleeve contribution measured via 3-variant decomp: (a) Core alone, (b) Core+Def no overlay, (c) Core+Def+Overlay. Def_contrib = (a) - (b). Overlay_contrib = (b) - (c). Simple (a)-(c) attribution BANNED. Def_contrib >= 2pp for multi_sleeve_core role claim.
gates.measurement: Forge must provide all 3 variants in performance.json. Judge validates arithmetic + 2pp threshold.

gates.name: tail_risk_schema_required

gates.action_on_breach: REJECT admission (Forge must re-run with compute_tail_risk_suite)

gates.name: clone_byte_identity_auto_reject
gates.threshold: SR/CAGR/MDD all 3-digit match with another strategy → clone triplicate
gates.measurement: Hash of (round(SR,3), round(CAGR,2), round(MDD,2)) against catalog
gates.action_on_breach: REJECT all clones except original; see L-151 (STR_1060/1070/1085)

gates.name: pairwise_tdc_le_0_4
gates.threshold: Lower-tail dependence coefficient lambda_L <= 0.4 vs ALL existing PG members
gates.measurement: t-copula MLE fit on pseudo-observations (pobs). lambda_L = 2 * pt(-sqrt((nu+1)(1-rho)/(1+rho)), df=nu+1) per Demarta-McNeil 2005. If MLE fails, closed-form with nu=4.
gates.action_on_breach: REJECT admission or require residualization (orthogonal component vs existing)
gates.r_code_template: library(copula); u<-pobs(r_cand); v<-pobs(r_existing); tau<-cor(u,v,method='kendall'); rho0<-sin(pi*tau/2); fit<-fitCopula(tCopula(rho0,dim=2,df=4), cbind(u,v), method='ml', start=c(rho0,4)); lambda_L <- 2*pt(-sqrt((fit@estimate[2]+1)*(1-fit@estimate[1])/(1+fit@estimate[1])), df=fit@estimate[2]+1)
gates.reference: Demarta & McNeil (2005) 'The t-Copula and Related Copulas'; Longin & Solnik (2001) crisis correlation escalation

gates.name: portfolio_cvar_95_annual_ge_neg_15pct
gates.measurement: Cornish-Fisher expansion on portfolio returns with new weight vector. R: cf_var_cf <- var_normal + (z_cf^3 - 3*z_cf)/6 * skew + ...
gates.action_on_breach: REJECT admission OR reduce weight until CVaR target met
gates.reference: Pfaff (2016) Financial Risk Modelling and Portfolio Optimization Ch.6

gates.name: portfolio_cdar_95_le_22pct
gates.threshold: Post-admission portfolio CDaR_95 <= 22%. Guided by CDaR/MDD ratio 0.75 rule-of-thumb.
gates.measurement: Rolling 95% drawdown on portfolio NAV. Compare to MDD proxy.
gates.action_on_breach: REJECT admission OR require Defense sleeve increment

gates.name: conservative_rho_0_3_primary_target
gates.threshold: Projected portfolio SR computed with rho=0.3 (pairwise avg correlation assumption) as base case. rho=0.2 only as optimistic scenario.
gates.measurement: SR_blend = (sum_i w_i * mu_i) / sqrt(w' * Sigma * w) where Sigma uses rho=0.3 off-diagonal.
gates.action_on_breach: Flag overstatement; Governor rev5 must report both scenarios

v2_to_v3_diff.philosophical_shift: v2.0 treated each strategy in isolation + simple corr. v3.0 treats admission as portfolio construction problem (conditional tail dep + CVaR/CDaR + rho base case).
